description: Create the Python processor sub-package tree: photo_extraction/, face_processing/, background_removal/, enhancement/, pipeline/ with all implementation files, plus processor/models.py with all Pydantic models. Update processor/requirements.txt and processor/Dockerfile. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 through FEAT-004.
steps: 1. Update processor/requirements.txt: add mediapipe==0.10.14 and scipy==1.14.1 to the existing 8 entries. Keep all existing pinned versions unchanged.

2. Update processor/Dockerfile: add 'libgl1' to the apt-get install line (after libgomp1) to satisfy mediapipe's OpenGL dependency. Change 'COPY app.py .' to 'COPY . .' so the entire processor/ package tree is copied into /app.

3. Create processor/models.py — all Pydantic v2 BaseModel classes used across the pipeline. Required models: ExtractionResult(ok, detected, confidence, corners_px: list[list[float]] | None, extracted_path: str | None, warning: str | None); FaceResult(ok, confidence, bbox: list[int], landmarks: list[list[float]], roll_angle: float, warning: str | None); AlignmentResult(ok, aligned_path: str, roll_corrected: float, crop_box: list[int]); SegmentationResult(ok, masked_path: str, coverage: float, warning: str | None); EnhancementResult(ok, enhanced_path: str, notes: list[str]); CropResult(ok, output_path: str, width: int, height: int); ValidationResult(ok, checks: dict[str, bool], error: str | None); ProcessV2Request(input_path, output_path, settings: dict, extracted_path: str | None = None, confirmed_corners: list[list[float]] | None = None); ProcessV2Response(ok, manual_review, detected_photo, stages: dict[str, str], error: str | None, output_path: str | None); ExtractOnlyRequest(input_path, work_dir); ExtractOnlyResponse(ok, confidence, extracted_path: str | None, corners_px: list[list[float]] | None, preview_path: str | None, warning: str | None); ConfirmCropRequest(input_path, corners_px: list[list[float]], work_dir); ConfirmCropResponse(ok, extracted_path, preview_path); CorrectRequest(extracted_path, output_path, settings: dict); CorrectResponse(ok, manual_review, stages: dict[str, str], error: str | None).

4. Create processor/photo_extraction/__init__.py (empty). Create processor/photo_extraction/boundary_detector.py: class BoundaryDetector. Method detect(bgr_image: np.ndarray) -> ExtractionResult. Algorithm: (a) Downsample to max 1600px. (b) Grayscale + GaussianBlur(5,5). (c) Canny(45,140). (d) findContours RETR_LIST + CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE. (e) For each contour: approxPolyDP at 2% perimeter; keep quads with area 3.5%-88% of image, aspect ratio 0.45-1.8. (f) Score candidates by area, aspect ratio proximity to 1.0, and convexity (cv2.isContourConvex). Return the highest-scoring quad's corners in [TL,TR,BR,BL] order. Confidence = (score / max_possible_score) clamped to [0,1]. If no quad found, confidence = 0.0. Use relative imports: from ..models import ExtractionResult.

5. Create processor/photo_extraction/quadrilateral_detector.py: class QuadrilateralDetector. Fallback strategy when boundary_detector confidence < 0.5. Method detect(bgr_image: np.ndarray) -> ExtractionResult. Algorithm: (a) Adaptive thresholding (cv2.adaptiveThreshold, ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, blockSize=11, C=2). (b) Morphological close with 3x3 kernel to close small gaps. (c) Hough line detection (cv2.HoughLinesP, threshold=80, minLineLength=50, maxLineGap=10). (d) Cluster lines into near-horizontal and near-vertical groups. (e) Find intersections to form rectangle corners. (f) Fallback: if fewer than 4 intersections, return the full image boundary as corners with confidence 0.3. Confidence derived from line coverage ratio.

6. Create processor/photo_extraction/perspective_corrector.py: class PerspectiveCorrector. Method correct(bgr_image, corners_px: list[list[float]]) -> np.ndarray. Uses cv2.getPerspectiveTransform + cv2.warpPerspective. Orders corners as TL/TR/BR/BL using sum/diff heuristic (same logic as existing quad_crop in app.py). Computes output width/height from max of opposing edge lengths. Returns rectified BGR image. Minimum output dimension check: if either dim < 100px, raises ValueError('Extracted region too small').

7. Create processor/photo_extraction/extraction_validator.py: class ExtractionValidator. Method validate(bgr_image: np.ndarray) -> ValidationResult. Checks: (a) min dimension >= 100px, (b) aspect ratio 0.3–3.0, (c) not uniform color (stddev of grayscale > 8). Returns ValidationResult with per-check dict and ok=all checks passed.

8. Create processor/photo_extraction/manual_crop.py: class ManualCrop. Method apply(bgr_image: np.ndarray, corners_px: list[list[float]]) -> np.ndarray. Delegates directly to PerspectiveCorrector.correct(). This class is the server-side handler for user-confirmed corners submitted via /process/confirm-crop. Use relative imports: from .perspective_corrector import PerspectiveCorrector.

9. Create processor/face_processing/__init__.py (empty). Create processor/face_processing/face_detector.py: class FaceDetector. Primary: MediaPipe FaceDetector (mp.solutions.face_detection.FaceDetection, min_detection_confidence=0.5). Fallback: OpenCV YuNet loaded from cv2.FaceDetectorYN (model file yunet.onnx auto-downloaded to U2NET_HOME if not present). Method detect(rgb_image: np.ndarray) -> FaceResult. Returns highest-confidence face bbox [x,y,w,h]. If no face found, ok=False. Do NOT use mediapipe.tasks (the newer Tasks API) — use the legacy mp.solutions.face_detection which is available in mediapipe 0.10.14.

10. Create processor/face_processing/landmark_detector.py: class LandmarkDetector. Uses MediaPipe FaceMesh (mp.solutions.face_mesh.FaceMesh, static_image_mode=True, max_num_faces=1, refine_landmarks=True). Method detect(rgb_image: np.ndarray, bbox: list[int]) -> FaceResult (populates landmarks field as list of [x,y] in pixel coordinates). Key landmarks extracted: left eye center (avg of indices 33,133,159,145), right eye center (avg of 362,263,386,374), chin (152), nose tip (1). Returns the updated FaceResult.

11. Create processor/face_processing/face_aligner.py: class FaceAligner. Method align(bgr_image: np.ndarray, face_result: FaceResult) -> AlignmentResult. Algorithm: (a) Compute eye midpoints from landmarks. (b) Calculate roll angle = atan2(dy, dx) of eye line in degrees. (c) If abs(roll) > 25 degrees: return ok=False, warning='Face too rotated — provide a frontal photograph'. (d) If abs(roll) > 0.5 degrees: rotate the full image around its center using cv2.getRotationMatrix2D + cv2.warpAffine (INTER_LANCZOS4, borderMode=BORDER_REFLECT). (e) Save rotated image to a temp path under work_dir. Returns AlignmentResult.

12. Create processor/face_processing/crop_calculator.py: class CropCalculator. Method calculate(aligned_bgr: np.ndarray, face_result: FaceResult, settings: dict) -> CropResult. Algorithm: (a) Use face bbox + landmarks. (b) Compute face height from chin landmark to top of bbox. (c) Headroom = face_height * 0.35. (d) Crop top = eye_y - headroom. (e) Crop width = face_height * 1.5, centered on face_x_center. (f) Target aspect from settings width/height. (g) Adjust crop to satisfy target aspect. (h) Clamp all crop coordinates to image bounds. (i) Resize to target dimensions using cv2.INTER_LANCZOS4. Returns CropResult with output_path.

13. Create processor/background_removal/__init__.py (empty). Create processor/background_removal/segmenter.py: class Segmenter. Uses rembg new_session() + remove() exactly as in the existing app.py. Model priority: first try SEGMENTATION_MODEL env var (default 'birefnet-general'), fallback to 'u2net_human_seg' if the primary session raises. Method segment(rgb_image: np.ndarray, session) -> SegmentationResult. Returns RGBA result as file path and coverage float. Coverage = fraction of alpha > 18 (same threshold as existing validate()). If coverage < 0.035 or > 0.83, sets ok=False with warning.

14. Create processor/background_removal/background_replacer.py: class BackgroundReplacer. Method replace(rgba_image: np.ndarray, background_color: tuple[int,int,int]) -> np.ndarray. Performs alpha compositing: foreground * (alpha/255) + bg_color * (1 - alpha/255). Returns RGB uint8 array. Parsing hex color string to RGB tuple lives here as a staticmethod parse_color(hex_str: str) -> tuple[int,int,int].

15. Create processor/background_removal/mask_refiner.py: class MaskRefiner. Method refine(alpha_channel: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray. Applies morphological operations to clean the segmentation mask: (a) cv2.morphologyEx MORPH_CLOSE with 3x3 kernel to close small holes. (b) cv2.GaussianBlur(3,3) on the mask edge for feathering. (c) Returns refined alpha channel. This is called between segmenter and background_replacer.

16. Create processor/enhancement/__init__.py (empty). Create processor/enhancement/enhancer.py: class Enhancer. Method enhance(rgb_image: np.ndarray, settings: dict) -> EnhancementResult. Steps: (a) Blur/quality check: if scipy.ndimage.laplace variance < 50 append note 'Image appears soft — original may be blurry'. (b) Denoising: cv2.fastNlMeansDenoisingColored(h=3, hColor=3, templateWindowSize=7, searchWindowSize=21). (c) If settings.get('enhance', True): PIL ImageEnhance.Color(1.03), Contrast(1.08), Sharpness(1.18), UnsharpMask(radius=1.2, percent=90, threshold=3) — same as existing enhance() in app.py. (d) Save to temp path. Returns EnhancementResult with notes list.

17. Create processor/enhancement/quality_checker.py: class QualityChecker. Method check(rgb_image: np.ndarray) -> dict. Returns dict with: blur_score (laplacian variance), resolution_ok (bool, min dim >= 200), noise_score (estimated), overall_quality ('good'|'fair'|'poor').

18. Create processor/pipeline/__init__.py (empty). Create processor/pipeline/pipeline.py: class PassportPipeline. Constructor takes work_dir: str. Method run_full(input_path, output_path, settings) -> ProcessV2Response. Method run_extract_only(input_path, work_dir) -> ExtractOnlyResponse. Method run_correct(extracted_path, output_path, settings) -> CorrectResponse. The run_full method orchestrates: BoundaryDetector → (if confidence < 0.5) QuadrilateralDetector → PerspectiveCorrector → ExtractionValidator → FaceDetector → LandmarkDetector → FaceAligner → Segmenter → MaskRefiner → BackgroundReplacer → Enhancer → CropCalculator → validate_final(). Each stage appends its stage name to a stages dict with value 'ok', 'skipped', or 'failed: <reason>'. On any stage failure, return early with ok=False and the stages dict populated up to that point. Saves intermediate files under work_dir using tempfile-style naming (e.g., {uuid}_extracted.jpg, {uuid}_aligned.jpg). Use relative imports: from ..photo_extraction.boundary_detector import BoundaryDetector, etc.

19. Create processor/pipeline/stage_runner.py: class StageRunner. Utility that wraps each pipeline stage call in try/except, records elapsed_ms, and returns a (result, stage_status_str) tuple. Used by PassportPipeline to keep run_full() readable. Method run(stage_name, fn, *args, **kwargs) -> tuple[Any, str].

20. Update processor/app.py: keep existing /health and /process endpoints exactly as-is (no changes to their logic or signatures). Add the following new FastAPI endpoints: POST /process/v2 (body: ProcessV2Request → ProcessV2Response), POST /process/extract-only (body: ExtractOnlyRequest → ExtractOnlyResponse), POST /process/confirm-crop (body: ConfirmCropRequest → ConfirmCropResponse), POST /process/correct (body: CorrectRequest → CorrectResponse), GET /models/status (returns dict of model name → loaded bool). Import the pipeline and models at top of file using absolute imports (from models import ...; from pipeline.pipeline import PassportPipeline). Add a module-level work_dir constant: WORK_DIR = os.getenv('WORK_DIR', '/tmp/snapid_work'); os.makedirs(WORK_DIR, exist_ok=True).
acceptance_criteria: processor/Dockerfile COPY line is 'COPY . .' and apt-get includes libgl1
processor/models.py defines all 12 Pydantic models listed in step 3

Python import smoke-test passes: 'from photo_extraction.boundary_detector import BoundaryDetector; from face_processing.face_detector import FaceDetector; from background_removal.segmenter import Segmenter; from enhancement.enhancer import Enhancer; from pipeline.pipeline import PassportPipeline; print(ALL OK)'

docker-compose exec processor python -c "from models import ExtractionResult, ProcessV2Request, ProcessV2Response; print('models OK')" — must print models OK
